symmetric.reason: The fully wetted potential-flow solution remains above cavity pressure on both checked meshes. No cavity is required by this model.
symmetric.scope: Steady 2-D upper partial-sheet potential flow with algebraic pressure recovery and the existing smooth-contact/BV estimator. No viscous separation, cloud shedding, erosion or experimental accuracy qualification.

wetPreflight.criterion: Every wetted sample Cp + target sigma >= 0 (roundoff only), on both meshes; positive clearance must also exceed the observed minimum-Cp mesh change.
wetPreflight.limitation: Potential-flow consistency screen; not observed inception, hysteresis or a cavitation experiment.
